notes.title: RESEARCH and DESTROY 9/27 Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the entire map could become purple, blocking progress.

notes.title: RESEARCH and DESTROY Patch 1.2 "Statistically Significant Update"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738524/cd3d79ad3bda80577a8d0645f61a1816e94181b1.png[/img]This update adds a wide variety of features and improvements requested by fans, in addition to numerous fixes and optimizations.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
●	“Opt-in” attack cameras
●	Multiplayer is now unlocked from the start
●	Some color-blindness correction options
●	Per-player difficulty level
●	Additional video options
●	Network optimization
●	General bug fixes and optimization

notes.title: Playtest (Closed Beta) Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738524/72e1cea809235bdbced07a2bb12cf27c8f658f1d.jpg[/img]
The Playtest (closed Beta) RESEARCH and DESTROY is now live! You will have received an e-mail notification if you were selected. 

[b]Beta Test Period:[/b]
June 22nd to July 27

If you weren't selected but really want to playtest the title, please let us know on our Discord channel!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/XtNvzj6eWG]Official Discord[/url]

[b]July 27 Update:[/b]
The closed beta playtest for RESEARCH and DESTROY has been concluded as of today. 

We would like to thank everyone who participated and to all users who sent in their feedback and bug reports to the dev team!

Please look forward to even more exciting news in the coming months as details about the game and its release are revealed!

notes.title: RESEARCH and DESTROY Closed Beta Sign-up Information
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738524/72e1cea809235bdbced07a2bb12cf27c8f658f1d.jpg[/img]
Closed beta sign-ups for RESEARCH and DESTROY will begin immediately following the conclusion of Steam Next Fest. 

[b]Beta Test Period:[/b]
June 22nd to July 27
UPDATE: Beta has been extended to July 27th!

You can sign up for the closed beta from the Steam product page by clicking on the green button that reads "Request Access".

Once you actually get started with the beta we'd love to hear about your experience so join the official RESEARCH and DESTROY Discord server for an exclusive opportunity to directly communicate with the developers and provide your valuable feedback. 

[url=https://discord.com/invite/XtNvzj6eWG]Official Discord[/url]
